title: 1RB1LC_1RC0RF_1RD0LB_1RE0LD_1LF---_0RA1LA: the third level in Lean, and the short tails close up
text: The short tails that the second-level resets leave lead to nine more and then to nothing new: 39 more resets, proved in Lean for every n, complete the table on levels 0 to 3 (one new suffix, 1011001). A second halting class appears (the tail 10 1101001 with r = 2, reached from level 2 when n ends in 6 or 7), and 29 classes in all never halt. The run is now a walk through a finite table of proved transitions; whether it halts turns on where level 2 ends, after about 10<sup>771</sup> phases.
